title: Sources: Nvidia made two separate introductions in 2022 connecting Alibaba with alleged Chinese spy Alice Huang, actively helping Megaspeed land Alibaba (The Information)
summary: The Information: Sources: Nvidia made two separate introductions in 2022 connecting Alibaba with alleged Chinese spy Alice Huang, actively helping Megaspeed land Alibaba — Nvidia's sales team introduced Chinese tech giant Alibaba to Alice Huang, the alleged Chinese spy involved in smuggling Nvidia chips into China …
